questions.q: Read «وَقَضْبًۭا» (80:28) and name two special qualities.
questions.a: ق: isti'la (raised, heavy); ض: istitalah (stretches along the side of the tongue).
و or ي sakin after fathah
options: و or ي sakin after fathah

questions.q: Special qualities hunt (pupil PDF): find an example of five special qualities in 'Abasa 80:25 to 33. Today's rota group recites 80:17 to 24.
questions.a: Safeer: صَبَبْنَا (80:25), وَزَيْتُونًۭا (80:29); qalqalah: the second ق of شَقَقْنَا (80:26); tafashshi: شَقَقْنَا (80:26); istitalah: ٱلْأَرْضَ (80:26); inhiraf: ل in لَّكُمْ (80:32).

questions.q: Extend: write the three safeer letters.
Stretch: why is takrir described but avoided in practice?
questions.a: Raa naturally tends to roll; reciters keep one tap so no extra raa is added.
A) ش. ش spreads through the mouth. س and ص have safeer (whistle).

questions.q: Think again: Some letters have a 'special talent': a whistle, a bounce, a spreading sound. Which letter do you think is most special, and why?
questions.a: Each has a gift: ص ز س whistle; ق ط ب ج د bounce; ش spreads; ض stretches along the tongue's side.
